objective: Independent seed-block replication of unchanged three-plan continuation selector, same five exposed opponents. Primary comparison: existing old_model; secondary: demand. Freeze selection rule and eight source scenarios before results. Report confidence by whole seed; do not promote solely on the small first-screen demand gain.
decision: Require useful improvement over old_model with credible seed uncertainty before integrating the selector. If inconclusive or worse, profile prediction errors and scenario feasibility.
